scope: 32 fixed identity-matched stations for primary app/model/replay cohort; original 42-station feasibility audit remains separate
selection: Training-qualified cohort intersect fixed captured 2026 identity evidence; no label/test/model performance filters

label_matching.method: nearest valid strictly after request, ties earlier, same split, reject >50m relocation
label_matching.missing: exclude, never zero or arbitrary forward fill

causal_features.rule: latest recorded valid observation at or before decision time only
causal_features.missing_or_stale: exclude request from this replay protocol; do not read future observations
causal_features.historical_publication_latency: unmeasured; source recorded timestamps are an explicit availability assumption

target_access: Future observations may be read only by offline labels/outcome evaluation; unavailable to model/planner input or action selection

od_estimation.split: train only, both trip times in train

historical_status: Broad In Service flag; do not invent installed/renting/returning/disabled fields
live_status: Check installed/renting/returning per current official GBFS; do not infer operability from identity mapping alone
limitations: 10-minute quantized observations, not exact continuous-time truth
2021 summer to 2026 domain/season shift needs current-data validation
Frozen cohort identity does not prove uninterrupted operation or current station service
